description: A Sphinx plugin module for filtering warnings based on configurable regular expressions, including classes for filtering and expression matching, and setup functions for integration with Sphinx.

classes.name: WarningsFilter
classes.description: A logging filter class that filters warning messages based on provided regular expressions and silent flag.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: A class encapsulating a regex pattern and tracking if it has matched any log line.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Initializes warning filtering expressions from config file and installs the filter into Sphinx logger handlers.

methods.name: finished
methods.description: Logs warnings for any expressions that did not match any log lines after build completion.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the Sphinx extension by adding configuration values and connecting event handlers.
